frequency_question: How often does a rate hike occur within any arbitrary 100-day span during an active hiking cycle?
membership_rule: Includes any continuous 100-day period falling within a recognized central bank rate-hiking cycle (e.g., RBI, Bank Indonesia, Banco Central do Brasil). Excludes flat or easing cycles.
